---
title: "p3 Features"
---

Makes the features and the four feature groups, then the five feature sets (M1 to M5).

Makes:

- data/shots_model.rds: one row per shot, the outcome and every feature
- outputs/feature_sets.rds: the features in each of the five models
- outputs/feature_groups.rds: the four feature groups

Pitch is 120 x 80 yards, goal centre at (120, 40), posts at y = 36 and y = 44. "Ahead of the shooter" = at or closer to the goal line than the shot (x >= shot x). "Outfield opponents" = opposition players excluding the keeper. What each StatsBombR feature means is in Methods 4.4.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
here::i_am("_pipeline/p3_features.qmd")

shots <- readRDS(here("data", "shots_final.rds"))
```

# Baseline features

DistToGoal comes from StatsBombR. Body part and play pattern are StatsBomb's own fields.

```{r}
features_baseline <- c("DistToGoal", "shot_angle", "shot.body_part.name", "assist_type", "play_pattern.name")
```

## Shot angle

Opening angle between the posts (y = 36 and 44), in degrees.

```{r}
shots <- shots |>
  mutate(shot_angle = atan2(8 * (120 - location.x),
                            (120 - location.x)^2 + (location.y - 40)^2 - 16) * 180 / pi)

summary(shots$shot_angle)
```

## Assist type and key pass details

```{r}
key_passes <- readRDS(here("data", "key_passes_raw.rds")) |>
  select(id, pass.type.name, pass.cross, pass.technique.name, pass.length, pass.height.name, pass.angle) |>
  mutate(pass.cross = replace_na(pass.cross, FALSE))

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(key_passes, by = c("shot.key_pass_id" = "id")) |>
  mutate(assist_type = case_when(
           is.na(shot.key_pass_id) ~ "None",
           pass.type.name %in% c("Corner", "Free Kick", "Throw-in", "Goal Kick", "Kick Off") ~ "Set piece",
           pass.cross ~ "Cross",
           pass.technique.name %in% "Through Ball" ~ "Through ball",
           TRUE ~ "Pass"),
         # key pass details, no key pass = 0 / "None" so those shots aren't dropped
         kp_length = replace_na(pass.length, 0),
         kp_angle = replace_na(pass.angle, 0),
         kp_height = replace_na(pass.height.name, "None"))

shots |> group_by(assist_type) |> summarise(shots = n(), conversion = mean(goal))
rm(key_passes)
```

# Spatial features

Five come from StatsBombR (DistToKeeper, DistSGK, AngleDeviation, DefendersInCone, distance.ToD1.360). gk_in_triangle and n_within_1m are made here.

```{r}
features_spatial <- c(features_baseline,
  "DistToKeeper", "gk_in_triangle", "DistSGK", "AngleDeviation", "DefendersInCone", "n_within_1m", "distance.ToD1.360")
```

## Counts, pressure and goal blocked from the freeze frame

Also makes the Extended Spatial ones that need the freeze frame (n_within_2m, n_within_3m, pressure_gauss, goal_blocked, teammates_in_box, teammates_within_3m).

```{r}
# total length of a set of intervals on the goal line, overlaps counted once
union_length <- function(lo, hi) {
  keep <- hi > lo
  lo <- lo[keep]
  hi <- hi[keep]
  if (length(lo) == 0) return(0)
  o <- order(lo)
  lo <- lo[o]
  hi <- hi[o]
  total <- 0
  cur_lo <- lo[1]
  cur_hi <- hi[1]
  for (i in seq_along(lo)[-1]) {
    if (lo[i] > cur_hi) {
      total <- total + cur_hi - cur_lo
      cur_lo <- lo[i]
      cur_hi <- hi[i]
    } else {
      cur_hi <- max(cur_hi, hi[i])
    }
  }
  total + cur_hi - cur_lo
}

# one row per player in each freeze frame
ff <- shots |>
  select(id, location.x, location.y, shot.freeze_frame) |>
  unnest(shot.freeze_frame) |>
  mutate(x = map_dbl(location, 1), y = map_dbl(location, 2),
         dist = sqrt((x - location.x)^2 + (y - location.y)^2))

opponents <- ff |> filter(!teammate)

# counts within about 1, 2, 3 metres (1 m = 1.094 yards), and gaussian pressure
pressure <- opponents |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(n_within_1m = sum(dist <= 1.1),
            n_within_2m = sum(dist <= 2.2),
            n_within_3m = sum(dist <= 3.3),
            pressure_gauss = sum(exp(-dist^2 / (2 * 1.5^2)))) # spread of 1.5 yards

# goal blocked: each opponent ahead of the shot casts a shadow on the goal line (posts at y = 36 and 44)
blocked <- opponents |>
  filter(x > location.x, location.x < 120) |>
  mutate(scale = (120 - location.x) / (x - location.x), # how much the shadow grows by the goal line
         centre = location.y + (y - location.y) * scale,
         half_width = 0.4 * scale, # body about 0.8 yards wide
         lo = pmax(centre - half_width, 36),
         hi = pmin(centre + half_width, 44)) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(goal_blocked = union_length(lo, hi) / 8) # share of the 8 yard goal covered

# teammates: how many in the box, and how many close by
teammates <- ff |>
  filter(teammate) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(teammates_in_box = sum(x >= 102 & y >= 18 & y <= 62),
            teammates_within_3m = sum(dist <= 3.3))

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(pressure, by = "id") |>
  left_join(blocked, by = "id") |>
  left_join(teammates, by = "id") |>
  mutate(across(c(n_within_1m, n_within_2m, n_within_3m, pressure_gauss, goal_blocked,
                  teammates_in_box, teammates_within_3m),
                \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) # none in the frame or none ahead = 0

rm(ff, opponents, pressure, blocked, teammates, union_length)

count(shots, n_within_1m)
summary(shots$goal_blocked) # 0 to 1
```

## gk_in_triangle

Keeper inside the triangle from the shot to the posts. gk_along = how far the keeper is from the shot to the goal line, 0 to 1.

```{r}
shots <- shots |>
  mutate(gk_along = (location.x.GK - location.x) / (120 - location.x),
         gk_in_triangle = as.integer(gk_along >= 0 & gk_along <= 1 &
           location.y.GK >= location.y + gk_along * (36 - location.y) &
           location.y.GK <= location.y + gk_along * (44 - location.y)))

shots |> group_by(gk_in_triangle) |> summarise(shots = n(), conversion = mean(goal))
```

# Extended Baseline features (no freeze frame)

StatsBomb fields used as they are: shot.first_time, shot.technique.name, shot.aerial_won, shot.one_on_one, shot.open_goal, shot.follows_dribble, under_pressure, minute, period, location.x, location.y. AngleToGoal comes from StatsBombR.

## Shooter position

```{r}
shots <- shots |>
  mutate(player_position = case_when(
           position.name == "Goalkeeper"                     ~ "def", # 7 shots, grouped with defenders
           str_detect(position.name, "Back")                 ~ "def",
           str_detect(position.name, "Midfield")             ~ "mid",
           str_detect(position.name, "Forward|Striker|Wing") ~ "att",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         player_position = factor(player_position, levels = c("def", "mid", "att")))

stopifnot(!anyNA(shots$player_position))
```

## Home or away

```{r}
load(here("data", "Comp_Match_Data.RData")) # Comp and Matches

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(Matches |> select(match_id, home_team = home_team.home_team_name), by = "match_id") |>
  mutate(is_home = as.integer(team.name == home_team))

stopifnot(!anyNA(shots$is_home))
rm(Comp, Matches)
```

## Goal difference before the shot

```{r}
all_goals <- readRDS(here("data", "shots_comp_info.rds")) |>
  filter(shot.outcome.name == "Goal", period < 5) |> # period 5 = penalty shootout
  select(match_id, goal_index = index, goal_team = team.name)

# own goals, team.name is the team that gets the goal
own_goals <- readRDS(here("data", "extra_events.rds"))$own_goals |>
  select(match_id, goal_index = index, goal_team = team.name)

goal_diff <- shots |>
  select(id, match_id, index, team.name) |>
  left_join(bind_rows(all_goals, own_goals), by = "match_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(goals_for = sum(goal_index < index & goal_team == team.name, na.rm = TRUE),
            goals_against = sum(goal_index < index & goal_team != team.name, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(goal_diff = goals_for - goals_against)

shots <- shots |> left_join(select(goal_diff, id, goal_diff), by = "id")
rm(all_goals, own_goals, goal_diff)
```

## Time on pitch

```{r}
subs <- readRDS(here("data", "extra_events.rds"))$subs |>
  filter(!is.na(player.id)) |>
  distinct(match_id, player.id, .keep_all = TRUE)

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(subs, by = c("match_id", "player.id")) |>
  mutate(time_on_pitch = minute - replace_na(sub_minute, 0)) |> # starters came on at 0
  select(-sub_minute)

rm(subs)
```

## Weak foot

```{r}
foot <- readRDS(here("data", "extra_events.rds"))$footedness |>
  select(player.id, DominantFoot)

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(foot, by = "player.id") |>
  mutate(weak_foot = as.integer(shot.body_part.name %in% c("Left Foot", "Right Foot") &
                                  !is.na(DominantFoot) &
                                  shot.body_part.name != DominantFoot)) |>
  select(-DominantFoot)

rm(foot)
```

## Possession time

Seconds from the start of the possession to the shot.

```{r}
poss_start <- readRDS(here("data", "extra_events.rds"))$poss_start

shots <- shots |>
  left_join(poss_start, by = c("match_id", "possession")) |>
  mutate(poss_time = (minute * 60 + second) - poss_start) |>
  select(-poss_start)

rm(poss_start)
```

## Rebound

1 if the same team had another shot in the previous 3 seconds (any shot type).

```{r}
earlier_shots <- readRDS(here("data", "shots_comp_info.rds")) |>
  filter(period < 5) |>
  transmute(match_id, team.name, period, prev_index = index, prev_t = minute * 60 + second)

rebounds <- shots |>
  transmute(id, match_id, team.name, period, index, t = minute * 60 + second) |>
  inner_join(earlier_shots, by = c("match_id", "team.name", "period"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(prev_index < index, t - prev_t <= 3) |>
  distinct(id)

shots <- shots |> mutate(is_rebound = as.integer(id %in% rebounds$id))
rm(earlier_shots, rebounds)
```

# Extended Spatial features

From StatsBombR: density, density.incone, InCone.GK, distance.ToD1, distance.ToD2, distance.ToD2.360, AttackersBehindBall, DefendersBehindBall, DefArea, AngleToKeeper, location.x.GK, location.y.GK. The freeze-frame counts, pressure_gauss and goal_blocked were made above.

```{r}
shots <- shots |>
  mutate(d1_magnitude = abs(distance.ToD1), # how far the nearest defender is, in front or behind
         d1_goalside = as.integer(distance.ToD1 > 0 & distance.ToD1 != 30)) # nearest defender ahead of the shooter
```

# Feature groups and feature sets

```{r}
extended_baseline <- c("shot.first_time", "shot.technique.name", "shot.aerial_won",
                       "shot.one_on_one", "shot.open_goal", "under_pressure",
                       "minute", "location.x", "location.y",
                       "player_position", "is_home", "goal_diff", "time_on_pitch", "weak_foot",
                       "shot.follows_dribble", "AngleToGoal", "period",
                       "poss_time", "kp_length", "kp_height", "kp_angle", "is_rebound")

extended_spatial <- c("density", "density.incone", "InCone.GK", "distance.ToD1",
                      "distance.ToD2.360", "AttackersBehindBall",
                      "DefendersBehindBall", "DefArea",
                      "d1_magnitude", "d1_goalside",
                      "AngleToKeeper", "location.x.GK", "location.y.GK", "distance.ToD2",
                      "n_within_2m", "n_within_3m", "pressure_gauss", "goal_blocked",
                      "teammates_in_box", "teammates_within_3m")

# the four groups, no overlap (names kept so the saved files still work)
standard <- features_baseline                           # Baseline
ff_core <- setdiff(features_spatial, features_baseline) # Spatial
context <- extended_baseline                            # Extended Baseline
ff_extra <- extended_spatial                            # Extended Spatial

feature_sets <- list(
  std = standard,                              # M1 Baseline
  std_ff = c(standard, ff_core),               # M2 Spatial
  std_ctx = c(standard, context),              # M3 Extended Baseline
  std_ctx_ff = c(standard, ff_core, context),  # M4 Extended Baseline + Spatial
  full = c(standard, ff_core, context, ff_extra)) # M5 Extended Spatial

lengths(feature_sets) # 5, 12, 27, 34, 54
```

# Saving the model data

```{r}
shots_model <- shots |>
  mutate(goal = as.integer(goal),
         shot.body_part.name = factor(shot.body_part.name),
         play_pattern.name = factor(play_pattern.name),
         assist_type = factor(assist_type),
         shot.technique.name = factor(shot.technique.name),
         kp_height = factor(kp_height),
         across(where(is.logical), as.integer)) |> # TRUE/FALSE to 1/0 so xgboost column names stay clean
  select(id, match_id, goal, shot.statsbomb_xg, all_of(feature_sets$full))

# drop shots missing any feature, so every model uses exactly the same shots
num_shots_before <- nrow(shots_model)
shots_model <- shots_model |> drop_na(all_of(feature_sets$full))
print(num_shots_before - nrow(shots_model)) # shots dropped

saveRDS(shots_model, here("data", "shots_model.rds"))
saveRDS(feature_sets, here("outputs", "feature_sets.rds"))
saveRDS(list(standard = standard, context = context, ff_core = ff_core, ff_extra = ff_extra),
        here("outputs", "feature_groups.rds"))
```
